system.description:
A potent hand-made weapon, Electrospears are used almost exclusively by Spears, who revere them as a symbol of their way of life and a legacy of their ancestors. Electrospears from fallen comrades are recovered and stored in Spear encampments, and each Spear will meditate surrounded by these weapons until they choose — or are chosen by — the weapon they will bear. Each Spear modifies and repairs their weapon throughout their lives, adding to their legacy. Each Electrospear is, essentially, an overcharged shock-prod with an extended, sharpened head — not especially sophisticated, but potent even against tough enemies such as mechs.

The profile for an Electrospear can be found in the Hand-Made Weapons Table at the start of this section. An Electrospear is a powered weapon, which recharges after a Breather rest. While recharging, the weapon may still be used as a normal spear.

Electrospears cannot be purchased — Spears don’t part with their traditional arms, but they’ll pay for weapons to be returned to them.
